content_text: Thank You for taking the time to read and respond, Roger. I Have recently started taking photographs with an analogue Minolta X-700 to pause and take a break from the unpredictable world of digital to find me again, I guess.. I have also purchased an Olympus MJU II for my wife, partially because it’s a small point and shoot with a great lens and quality and partially because of Wim Wenders 🙂  Have a wonderful day and thank You again! All the very best. Timur
